The club's volunteer work splits into three teams under the board, and each team has two standing duties.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  board["Board"] --> events["Events team"]
  board --> grounds["Grounds team"]
  board --> youth["Youth team"]
  events --> e1["Summer fair"]
  events --> e2["Winter market"]
  grounds --> g1["Field upkeep"]
  grounds --> g2["Equipment shed"]
  youth --> y1["Saturday training"]
  youth --> y2["Holiday camp"]
```

New volunteers usually start in the grounds team, since its duties need the least coordination.
